text: 11月13日，国务院召开全国冬春农田水利暨高标准农田建设视频会议。中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李强日前对推进农田水利和高标准农田建设作出重要批示。批示指出：农田水利和高标准农田建设是夯实国家粮食安全根基的重要抓手。近年来，各地区各有关部门持续加强农田建设，为巩固提升粮食综合生产能力、增强农业防灾减灾能力发挥了关键作用。
text_en: On November 13, the State Council held a video conference on national winter-spring farmland water conservancy and high-standard farmland construction. Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, recently made important instructions on advancing farmland water conservancy and high-standard farmland construction. The instructions pointed out: farmland water conservancy and high-standard farmland construction are important levers for consolidating the foundation of national food security. In recent years, all regions and relevant departments have continued to strengthen farmland construction, playing a key role in consolidating and improving comprehensive grain production capacity and enhancing agriculture's disaster prevention and mitigation capabilities.
